Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J
Mr. Dinesh Gahatori, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Koranga and Mr. 
R.C. Joshi, learned Brief Holders for the State.
3. Mr. S.K. Mandal, learned counsel for 
respondent no.4.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that the present matter is squarely 
covered by the judgment of the Division Bench 
of this Court in SPA No.940 of 2018, State of 
Uttarakhand & others vs. Balraj Singh Negi
dated 10.04.2024.
5. Learned counsel for the State as well as 
the learned counsel for respondent no.4 is 
granted two weeks’ time to seek instructions in 
the matter as to whether the matter is squarely 
covered by the aforesaid judgment or not.
6. List on 04.06.2024 immediately after 
fresh cases.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)

Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Dinesh Gahtori, Advocate for the 
petitioners.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, D.A.G. for the 
State/respondent nos. 1 to 3.
Mr. S.K. Mandal, Advocate for the 
respondent no.4.
Arguments heard, but not concluded.
It appears that certain more pleadings 
are required to be submitted by the 
respondent no.4.
Let the respondent no.4 may file a 
reply to the para 6 of the writ petition 
where the petitioner has stated that he was 
regularized by the Chairman of the Board 
w.e.f. 01.04.1997 and Annexure 6 to the 
writ petition has been produced as a proof 
of it.
Let such short counter affidavit be 
filed within three weeks.
List thereafter.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 22.05.2025
